curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: realise the importance of fluency in lifelong learning.

interactions.prompt: What does a fluent reader do?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Fluent reading sounds smooth and clear.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the reading that is easiest to understand.

interactions.prompt: Why does Teacher reread 'The sun is hot'?
Which habit helps you become a fluent reader?
interactions.retryHint: Choose the habit that gives regular practice.

interactions.prompt: Fluent reading helps Asha learn from which item?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Fluency helps Asha enjoy and learn from books.
interactions.retryHint: Which item contains words to read?

interactions.prompt: At the clinic, why is fluent reading useful?
choices: It helps us understand a health poster
interactions.answer: It helps us understand a health poster
interactions.feedback: Well done! Reading fluently supports learning everywhere.

choices: I will practise reading to learn new things
I will read only one day ever
I will skip words I do not know
interactions.answer: I will practise reading to learn new things
interactions.feedback: Fluency champion! Practice helps you learn throughout life.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the promise that keeps learning growing.
